  <p>The Bioinformatics Hackathon in TURKU 11th of MARCH @ 15</p>
  </div>
  <div class="text-large" style="font-size:22px;">
  <p>NEXT: 8th of APRIL , 15th of MAY, 3rd of JUNE</p>
  </div>
  <p>The Finnish Society for Bioinformatics is excited to host beginners
  Bioinformatics hackathon in collaboration with InFlames Research Flagship
  and CompLifeSci in Turku during spring 2025.</p>

  <p>The beginners Bioinformatics hackathon is aimed for everyone interested
  in Bioinformatics – no prior coding experience is needed. The hackatons are
  low threshold, fun events to get everyone as excited of bioinformatics as we
  are. We will cover topics like Linux command line, Git, workflows, and containers.</p>

  <p>No registration needed, just appear in BioCity 4th floor seminar room and bring
  your laptop, you might end up writing your first line of code!</p>
